notes.title: New Release - Gothic 3: Forsaken Gods Enhanced Edition
notes.notes:
Gothic 3: Forsaken Gods Enhanced Edition is now available on Steam. In commemoration of its release, all Gothic games, including Forsaken Gods Enhanced Edition, is available at 75% off now through Thursday, March 24th 2011 10am PDT.

Gothic 3: Forsaken Gods Enhanced Edition is a completely remastered version of the official add-on to Gothic 3 that includes new quests, monsters, weapons and armors with revamped graphics and updated combat system. This standalone quest (Gothic 3 is not required to play the add-on) will answer all questions which have risen in the past and will slowly introduce fans to a new chapter.
